prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a hyper-realistic 4K candid nightlife photograph of a generic clearly adult woman with long, messy copper-red hair and heavy blush, leaning into the camera and pointing a finger gun at the viewer. She has an energetic playful expression, slight wink, open-mouth laugh and glossy lips. She wears a black sleeveless buckled top with a large rectangular buckle and a leopard-print shoulder bag. The background is a crowded dark club with a blonde adult woman in glossy pants turned away, a bearded man in a white shirt and a heavily tattooed adult man in the deeper background. The foreground includes a table with white drink cups and a black energy-drink can with unreadable labeling. Shoot with hard direct flash, high contrast, highly detailed natural skin texture, raw party atmosphere, slight film grain and 4K HD quality. Preserve the source gesture, outfit, crowd and direct-flash intent without reproducing Sadie Sink or any public-figure likeness.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, sexual pose, celebrity likeness, public-figure likeness, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, over-saturated, airbrushed, HDR look, watermark, extra fingers, deformed, distorted hands, readable brand logo, duplicate people
